description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Your legs transform into that of an unnatural being. Roll on the @Table[unnatural-body] Table to determine which type of being that lends its features to you. The mutated limbs remain functional, but may have positive or negative modifiers. You can only gain this mutation once. Unnatural Body Table Traits and effects like Armour, Magical, Daemonic, Infected and Painless only affect the mutated body parts. Once you've received a mutation from this list you may choose to pick that same type again instead of rolling on the table.
